topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and sets expectations for the lecture on the complement system.

topics.label: Foundations and central mechanics of the complement cascade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the foundational organization, nomenclature rules, and central biochemical role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three upstream recognition pathways that trigger complement activation and converge on the central threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream immunological mechanisms activated complement deploys to neutralize and eliminate pathogens.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins host cells utilize to inhibit complement activation and protect themselves from lysis.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct pathological presentations and disease susceptibilities resulting from specific complement component deficiencies.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion mechanisms and biotechnology applications
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the strategies pathogens employ to escape complement-mediated clearance and the practical applications derived from them.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the closing framing for the lecture and indicates the topic of the following session.
